notes: Run of 2026-11-18. Five Standard stories queued. One earns an entry: the renovation of the China Basin office complex at 185 Berry Street and its leasing to Sierra. The Lorella bakery delay at 2139 Polk Street is a postponement of an opening the page already carries; declined. The rest print no address the story is about.

findings.description: The China Basin office complex at 185 Berry Street, two buildings on the channel opposite Oracle Park, got a ground-floor renovation paid for by majority owner J.P. Morgan with McCarthy Cook managing: Water's Edge, a cafe, coworking, lounge and event space open to the public, and a restaurant, Sergeant Ma; Sierra has since become the largest tenant (350,000 sq ft, then 93,000 more). The article says the complex was built in 1920 for industrial maritime use and repurposed as offices in 1991.

extra.ground_floor: Water's Edge; Sergeant Ma (Hi Neighbor Hospitality Group)

citation.label: The San Francisco Standard, “The pandemic forced a reinvention at China Basin. Then Sierra AI moved in,” 17 November 2026

raw.text: The office complex at 185 Berry St. sits on the channel just across from Oracle Park

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 185 BERRY ST → parcel 3803005; sf-parcels has blklot 3803005 active, 980–980 03RD; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1920. EAS puts 105, 185 BERRY ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 105.
